image_purpose: Introduces the height-matching game with a humorous tone, featuring game title.

composition.primary_dinosaur: A colossal, friendly-looking Brachiosaurus (or Apatosaurus) filling the left two-thirds of the frame. Its head is tilted in exaggerated confusion, with a large, expressive eye looking down at the stack.
composition.stacked_dinosaurs: On the right, a comically precarious, leaning tower of 4-5 smaller, distinct dinosaurs, stacked vertically. Each dinosaur in the stack has a slightly bewildered, straining, or comically determined expression. The stack should appear wobbly but stable enough for the image.
composition.perspective: Slightly low-angle to emphasize height difference and the towering Brachiosaurus.

text_overlay.caption: Measure the Dinosaur
text_overlay.color: Bright, vivid red with a subtle white or light outline for contrast.
text_overlay.position: Upper center, integrated naturally into the sky or above the stacked dinosaurs, not obscuring any dinosaur faces. It should look like part of the scene, not just pasted on.
text_overlay.effect: Subtle 3D depth, casting a soft, playful shadow.

composition.overall_mood: Whimsical, humorous, slightly absurd, and very friendly.

character_details.expressions: Exaggerated confusion, determination, mild discomfort, or bewilderment on all dinosaurs' faces. Big, cartoonish eyes.
character_details.texture: Smooth, vibrant, clean animated-style textures. Soft, matte skin/feathers. No scales, no grit, no scary elements.
character_details.colors: Bright, playful color palette. Contrast between the large dinosaur and the stacked ones. Think vibrant greens, blues, oranges, and yellows.

environmental_details.background: Simple, bright, stylized prehistoric landscape. Rolling green hills, a few cartoonish palm trees, and a clear, happy blue sky with fluffy white clouds.
environmental_details.lighting: Bright, even, cheerful daylight. Soft, friendly shadows.

negative_prompt: serious, aggressive, scary, realistic, hyper-detailed, grim, dull colors, dark, muddy, violent, sharp teeth, blood, fighting, falling, collapsing stack (should look precarious but stable for the image)
